instructions: **Before you begin:** this sheet must be completed in full before the matter it concerns can be considered to exist. Incomplete sheets are not rejected — they are filed alongside complete ones, in the same drawer, in no particular order.
**Notice:** answers given on this sheet may contradict answers given on a previous sheet. Where they do, both are kept and neither is preferred.
**Important:** do not leave any field blank. A blank field is read by {{officer}} as an admission, though of what has not been determined.
**Please note:** the Concern is a pacifist commercial entity and will not respond to this filing with force. It will respond with correspondence, which is worse.
**Before proceeding:** confirm that you have read Form {{form}}. You have not. Confirm it anyway.
**Declaring parties are reminded** that the Concern knows where every faction in this sector is and discloses none of them, including yours, including to you.
**Warning:** completing this sheet does not advance your matter. Nothing advances your matter. Your matter is stationary by design.
**Procedural note:** some information requested below has been requested before. The Office requires it again, in the form now asked.
**Attention:** the Office does not accept spoken declarations, broadcasts, or strongly worded signage. Those are not filings. They are kept without being read.
**Guidance:** where a question resembles one you have already answered, answer it as though you had not.

finePrint: By filing, the declaring party acknowledges that this form does not constitute acceptance, rejection, or acknowledgement of any grievance, hostility, or correspondence, and may generate further forms.
Filing creates no obligation on the part of the Concern, and no right on the part of the declaring party, other than the right to file again.
The Concern is a pacifist commercial entity. Nothing in this form should be read as a threat, a promise, or an intention to act.
Filings are kept indefinitely and reviewed at the Office’s convenience, which has not yet arisen.
This form was generated automatically. It is nonetheless binding to the same extent as a form that was not, which is to say not at all.
The Office reserves the right to request this information again, on a different sheet, in different words.
Answers may be used to generate additional questions. This is the intended operation of the system, not a defect.
Neither the completion nor the abandonment of this form affects the underlying matter, which is stationary.
transmittals: **Transmittal:** send this copy to the Consolidated Industrial Concern together with every copy saved before it. Copies sent out of order are re-ordered, then filed out of order.
**Transmittal:** this copy must accompany Form GC-1 and all continuation sheets. A missing sheet invalidates nothing, and is noted.
**Transmittal:** keep a duplicate of this copy. Keep a duplicate of the duplicate. Send neither until the other has been sent.
**Transmittal:** deliver to {{dept}} by the channel through which your declaration was made. {{officer}} will sign for it on return from leave.
**Transmittal:** this sheet is to be filed with the Concern in its entirety. Partial sheets are accepted and treated as entire.
**Transmittal:** forward this copy to the Concern for entry in {{ledger}}. Receipt will not be acknowledged, which constitutes acknowledgement.
